traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Podostemaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple or compound; plants hermaphrodite; ovary superior; stems herbaceous; flowers usually solitary, often in cymes; flowers actinomorphic or zygomorphic; perianth usually absent, sometimes tepals; fruit capsule; stamens 1 to 30; carpels (1-) 2 (-3). Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
